researchLog.note: Round 4 searched without result: Akerly 1898 full text: 'Gooch' occurs only in Henry Tuthill's will abstract (John Gooch); no William or Peter Gooch
Round 4: Akerly's abstract of Henry Tuthill's 1618 will names John (not William) Gooch as father-in-law; the William/Peter 'Ilketshall' Gooch chain is unsupported.

conflicts.site: Tree chain Peter 'Ilketshall' Gooch -> William Gooch (1523-1605) -> 'Wyllyam' Gooch (1559-1636) as the Tuthill in-laws
conflicts.found: Henry Tuthill of Tharston's will (20 Mar 1618, proved 20 Apr 1619) names his wife's father as JOHN Gooch and her mother as Margaret Rau(e); Akerly prints the wife only as 'Alice (Gooch?)'.
conflicts.assessment: The documented father-in-law is John Gooch, not William. Nothing ties the tree's William Gooch (1523-1605, Ilketshall) to Alice Gooch. 'Ilketshall' is a Suffolk place name (the Ilketshall parishes near Bungay) used as a middle name, a typical sign of a merged online tree. Treat as unsupported.

openQuestions: Is there any record linking a William Gooch of Ilketshall/Wissett to John Gooch of Long Stratton, father of Alice Gooch (bapt. Long Stratton 11 Aug 1583 per WikiTree)?
